name: auth-shell
title: Auth shell
description: Sign in frame: a white form card on a blue ring panel over ruler hairlines, a legal line, and a rotating customer quote from lg.
usage: The frame of the sign in, sign up and reset password pages (LoginPage and SignupPage are built on it). Put an AuthCard with an AuthHeader in AuthPageShell; set `imageHeight` (px) so the panel fits the card, and `imageMinHeight` to let it shrink on short windows. Pass the privacy and terms links as `legal` and an AuthProofPanel as `aside`. Style inputs with `AUTH_INPUT` in a Field (label in AuthLabel), the submit with `variant="pill"` and `AUTH_SUBMIT`, links with `AUTH_LINK` or `AUTH_MUTED_LINK`, a blue note with `AUTH_NOTICE`. PasswordInput adds the show and hide button; AuthSocialButtons the round provider buttons with the "Last used" tag.
avoid: The site header or footer around it
notes:
The proof panel's quote moves every ten seconds while the active avatar's ring fills (a linear progress, drawn with the
Web Animations API); picking an avatar restarts it, and under reduced motion the ring stays empty. The password eyes
cross-fade in place (opacity and a slight scale, 150ms ease-out); provider buttons and links change only color or fill
on hover. The site shows customer photos in the avatars; without an `avatar`, initials stand in.
